text:
morgan: Heads up, spotted a weird mismatch on the latency dashboard — p99 for /v1/generate aggregate jumped to ~720ms at 10:12 but the endpoint breakdown p99 sits around 230ms. anyone seen this before?
lee: I noticed a tail in traces too. my quick intuition: different sample origins or retries counted in one but not the other.
nana: which dashboard/time range? and are you on the default provenance merge?
morgan: 2026-03-22 10:00->10:20 UTC, using the dashboard default view. I thought that merged origins.
lee: pulled a couple of ingress log lines: ingress: endpoint=/v1/generate route=eu-west fallback=true latency_ms=702 retry_count=1 origin=proxy
kai: that explains a lot — we recently changed endpoint slice defaults to hide proxy-origin samples. aggregate view keeps them. so if fallback traffic (proxy) is slow and included in aggregate, they diverge.
morgan: ah. the console doesn't show an origin badge on the p99 line currently, so it was pretty misleading.
lee: UX gap for sure. we should show a small provenance pill next to percentile numbers when origins differ. also hover should show counts by origin.
nana: another factor: at ~10:11 the canary bumped fallback weight for eu-west to 20% for a short window. fallback path has more retries and higher tail. ops-bot?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary/2026-03-22.10 rolled to eu-west at 10:09
lee: timing matches. so contributors = rollout weight shift + proxy samples + retries.
kai: quick repro query I ran: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, sample_origin, count(*) FROM telemetry.samples WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND time >= '2026-03-22T10:00Z' AND time <= '2026-03-22T10:20Z' GROUP BY sample_origin ORDER BY p99 DESC;` shows proxy p99 ~= 710ms, server p99 ~= 220ms.
morgan: action items: 1) add provenance pill for percentile lines, 2) show sample counts and origin breakdown in hover, 3) surface when endpoint slice defaults differ from aggregate semantics.
lee: also propose an "include retries" toggle on percentile queries. retries are silently skewing a lot of our dashboards.
kai: implementation notes: backend telemetry already tags `sample_origin` and `retry_count`. toggles can map to `retry_count = 0` filter by default. small console PR to add badge + tooltip should be low risk.
nana: i'll draft a short docs blurb explaining why p50/p95/p99 can differ across slices (origins, retries, fallback routing, cache hits).
morgan: can we target the UX patch (badge + tooltip) in the next sprint as a hotfix? reduces misinterpretation.
lee: i'll add the include-retries param to the query service and attach sample counts to the percentile response.
kai: i'll open the console PR for the badge and hover with a link to the query that produced the numbers.
ops-bot: incident-tracker: created INC-2026-03122 (latency-dashboard-provenance-mismatch) -> assigned to eng-platform
morgan: thanks team. short post-incident note: root cause = canary fallback weight spike + inconsistent provenance defaults + retries counted in aggregate. low-risk fixes planned. :+1:
lee: i'll paste the diagnostic query and some traces into the incident ticket now.
